sectors.title: ARCHIVE SECTOR
sectors.subtitle: STORAGE · SEALED
locked: It was sealed by something that is still running.
You do not have ACCESS. Ask the system for it and it will ask you for less than you think.

sectors.title: SECURITY SECTOR
sectors.subtitle: PRIVILEGED PROCESS
locked: This process answers only to the Core.
Find something the Core wants more than it wants you gone.

sectors.title: CORRUPTED ZONE
sectors.subtitle: INTEGRITY FAILURE
locked: This data is not supposed to still be running.

sectors.title: THE CORE
sectors.subtitle: ADMINISTRATIVE LAYER
locked: The Core has no interface. It has outcomes.
Do not come here. That is not a warning, it is the last instruction the system gives you before it stops giving instructions.
